notes.title: Rainyday patch 1.42
notes.content:
*Patch Notes (v.1.42)*

-For increased atmosphere Rainyday now runs in full screen by default!

-Taxi bug fixed!

-Minor tweaks and bugs fixed.

notes.title: Episode 2: Kids RELEASED
notes.content:
Rainyday Episode 2: Kids is finally here! Newest episode is playable right a way and it comes with a patch 1.4.

*Patch Notes (v1.4)*

-NEW PLAYABLE EPISODE!

-2 new Steam achievements

-Added four new ways to die

-Rain looks even more realistic

-Various bugs fixed (thanks to players for pointing these out)

notes.title: Rainyday patch 1.25 released
notes.content:
*Patch Notes (v1.25)*

-Added pharmacy-map

-Pause menu fixed

-Fixed a bug that was causing footstep sounds to keep looping when getting hit by a car and dying

-Fixed a bug that was causing player to spawn to incorrect location on map when leaving Kevin Ross' house in episode1

notes.title: Rainyday 1.2 released
notes.content:
*Patch Notes (v1.2)*

-Added incredibly realistic walking animations for John Rainy.
-Bar can now be accessed at any time.

-Fixed bug when changing resolution at the main menu.
-Some minor bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

notes.title: Only six nights for the Episode 1: Gris-gris!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30630419/893b96d911384c49210e8172de5f9f3bab1b1772.png[/img]

Welcome to rainy hell.
